text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — we just flagged a pattern where a slice of new activations saw higher-than-expected embedding latency during the activation index job window. customers affected are mostly trial cohorts from last 48h. drafting a short external note + optional credit offer. want ideas on mitigation language and technical root we can share.

sanjay_support: confirmed a handful of support tickets. customers report slow search and docs not returning immediately. i put a temp tag on the tickets: IMPACT-ACTIVATION-HUB.

eli_engineering: digging in now. initial traces show long tail on the embed worker queue during the 02:00–03:30 UTC maintenance window. looks like a backpressure loop after a retry storm.

jordan_se: for renewals team — a couple of these are high-touch trials with upcoming renewal conversations. can we put a conservative customer-facing ETA for remediation and offer a 10% credit for the affected window?

olivia_product: +1 to a clear ETA and a small credit. also want to offer an invite to a 1:1 onboarding clinic (30m) to review index/perf best practices for qualified accounts. keeps customers engaged.

maria_cs: draft external message (short):

"We experienced elevated embedding latency for a subset of recent activations during a maintenance window. Our engineering team identified a retry storm that increased indexing time for affected projects. We’ve deployed a fix that reduces retries and prevents queue backpressure. Affected customers will see their index complete; if your activation is still delayed, reply here and we’ll fast-track it. We’re offering a one-time credit and an optional onboarding session for impacted customers. Apologies for the disruption — we’re following up with a full technical summary and next steps."

eli_engineering: suggested technical blurb for CS (short):

"Root cause: a retry amplification loop in the embedding ingestion worker during a partial rollout of a queue change. The worker retried failed tasks aggressively which caused queue saturation and latency spikes. Fix: rate-limited retries + improved circuit-breaker on the ingestion queue. Follow-up: we’ll run a sweep to reprocess stuck items and add a synthetic monitor for retry amplification."

anne_cs_manager: want the external message to be empathetic + explicit about timeline. propose adding: "We expect index completion for most customers within 4 hours of this message; if you need immediate assistance, reply and we’ll prioritize you."

maria_cs: updated draft with timeline + credit mention. beginning to segment affected accounts and will send tailored messages to the top 20 accounts first. uploading csv to the shared drive in a sec.

jordan_se: please include renewal risk flag on the CSV (column: renewal_risk = high/med/low). i’ll coordinate outreach for high.

maria_cs: added renewal_risk column. shared link: https://internal.redwood/drive/activation-latency-impacted-1769954322.csv :eyes:

eli_engineering: operational mitigation checklist we ran:
```
- rolled back partial queue optimization
- deployed retry limiter (0.5 req/s per worker)
- triggered reprocess job for stuck embeds (id range: 1623400-1624500)
- enabled synthetic monitor for embed latency
```

sanjay_support: can we standardize the canned CS response for tickets? draft: "We’re aware of elevated activation latency for some customers; engineering has deployed a fix and is reprocessing affected items. Expected completion within 4 hours. If your activation is still pending after that, reply and we’ll escalate."

olivia_product: approve canned response. also recommend a short FAQ pointer: "Why did this happen?" + "How will this affect my account?" + next steps link. i’ll create the FAQ doc and link it in the message.

maria_cs: i’ll post the external message to impacted customers in two waves: 1) top 20 high-touch (manual personalize), 2) bulk note for the rest. sending wave 1 in ~20m. cc @anne_cs_manager for sign-off.

anne_cs_manager: sign-off for wave 1. please copy legal on the message batch for credit language.

opsbot: Deployment complete: retry limiter v1 -> rolled to production at 1769954880. No new errors reported in last 5m.

eli_engineering: monitoring looks steady. starting reprocess; ETA for reprocess completion estimate: 2–3 hours for current backlog. will update if anything changes.

maria_cs: thanks all. post-wave-1 checklist: 1) capture customer replies and tag tickets with IMPACT-ACTIVATION-HUB, 2) log any asks for expedited reindexing in the shared sheet, 3) schedule a follow-up summary message in 6 hours with a short RCA and credit instructions.

jordan_se: i’ll prepare renewal playbook snippets for high-risk accounts to offer extra touches (discount + onboarding session).

olivia_product: created FAQ draft and put link in the shared doc. maria, want the link added to the customer message or as a follow-up?

maria_cs: add to initial message (short link). also prepare a 1:1 calendar template for onboarding clinics.

eli_engineering: leaving a final note for the RCA doc: we’ll include timelines, root cause summary, mitigation steps taken, and long-term corrective actions (circuit-breaker tuning, retry telemetry alerts, traffic shaping during rollouts).

maria_cs: perfect. i’ll send wave 1 now and post an internal recap after wave 1 completes. thanks everyone. :pray:
